description: Generate a pytest suite that runs every prompt variant against every fixture. When prompt variants must be checked against a fixture set. Do not choose this when you need the model outputs compared, which needs a model call. Example requests: Build a regression suite for these prompt variants. | Generate prompt tests from my variants and fixtures. | Set up a prompt regression harness.

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

fixtures.description: The customer's fixtures.csv, as text. Supported: CSV with a header row. Fixture inputs. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

variants.description: The customer's variants.txt, as text. Supported: Plain text. One prompt variant per line. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.

name: submit_prompt_regression_suite
title: Prompt regression suite
